card.name: Overdose and poisoning warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside overdose or poisoning statements, such as 'children' after 'fatal poisoning in' or the start of 'ingestions' and 'overdosage'. Also fires on a stray author-initial period in a reference.

modes.label: Iron overdose warning
modes.description: The word 'children' in the standard iron-product warning about fatal poisoning in children under 6.
modes.example: WARNING: Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in<< children>> under 6. Keep this product out

modes.label: Overdosage section wording
modes.description: Partway through 'ingestions' or 'overdosage' in overdose discussions.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE There has been limited experience with overdosage. Reported acute<< ingest>>ions of up to 18 g

modes.label: Citation initial
modes.description: The period after an author's first initial in a reference list.
modes.example: . Cite them right : the essential referencing guide 8th ed. Basingstoke: Palgrave Macmillan - Williams, K<<.>> 2009. Referencing
